data.name: Aklesh
data.gender_notes: Aklesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aklesh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ak’ (strong) and ‘Lesh’ (one who conquers). This name is associated with bravery, strength, and victory. The name Aklesh carries the meaning “Strong, One who Conquers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aklesh usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, one who conquers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage needed to overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Aklesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, One who Conquers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aklesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
